	public static double d2(double ax, double ay, double bx, double by)
	{
		return (bx - ax) * (bx - ax) + (by - ay) * (by - ay);

	// Returns angles of intersection points between two circles
	// Returns empty array if no intersection, or 2 angles for each intersection point
	public static double[] crossSimple(long x, long y, long r, long tx, long ty, long tr)
	{
		long dx = tx - x;
		long dy = ty - y;
		long d2 = dx*dx + dy*dy;
		long r2 = r*r;
		long tr2 = tr*tr;
		
		// Check for no intersection
		if (d2 > (r + tr)*(r + tr) + 1) return new double[0]; // too far apart
		if (d2 < (r - tr)*(r - tr) - 1) return new double[0]; // one inside other without touching
		
		// Handle tangent cases
		if (Math.abs(d2 - (r + tr)*(r + tr)) < 1) {
			// externally tangent - one point
			double base = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
			return new double[]{base, base};
		}
		if (Math.abs(d2 - (r - tr)*(r - tr)) < 1) {
			// internally tangent - one point
			double base = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
			if (r > tr) base += Math.PI;
			return new double[]{base, base};
		}
		
		double d = Math.sqrt(d2);
		double base = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
		
		// Law of cosines: cos(angle) = (r^2 + d^2 - tr^2) / (2*r*d)
		double cosAngle = (r2 + d2 - tr2) / (2.0 * r * d);
		// Clamp to [-1, 1] to avoid floating point errors
		cosAngle = Math.max(-1.0, Math.min(1.0, cosAngle));
		double wing = Math.acos(cosAngle);
		
		double angle1 = base - wing;
		double angle2 = base + wing;
		
		return new double[]{angle1, angle2};
	}
	
	public static long d2(long ax, long ay, long bx, long by)
